title: Investigating Memorization of Conspiracy Theories in Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting pre-trained language models (GPT-2) with conspiracy-related topics and generic prompts, then evaluating the outputs using human annotators (Amazon Mechanical Turk) to determine if the generated text affirms the conspiracy theories. The methodology also includes automated evaluations using sentiment analysis, diversity metrics (BERTScore), and comparing model perplexity with Google search results overlap (BLEU).
